name: @openagt/ui-renderer-markdown
description: How a text in markdown looks wherever the dashboard shows one, an agent's reply, a ticket, a file read as a page: headings, lists, tables, links, and code coloured by its language, a fenced block another module draws in its place.

scripts.prepack: node -e "if(!process.env.npm_config_user_agent?.startsWith('pnpm/')){console.error('Pack and publish with pnpm: it replaces workspace:* with the real version, npm does not');process.exit(1)}"
